name: Ryle Ainsworth
original_name: ライル・エインズワース
source:
Hunters are already rare,and it is said that only one in every 100 hunters are born as males. Of the new recruits this year, only he and Justine are enrolled.

After losing his parents, he was raised by relatives. He and Monica are childhood friends that live next to each other.

He was living in the countryside when suddenly he was attacked by a monster. After fighting it off with Monica, he discovered his potential as a hunter.

His weapon is a sword and doesn't have a favorite subject.
